title: CRTF.PROG.------POL.P.
description: First of two diagrams in T(IMP)M-33. The crossing diagrams how creative-progression structurally meets political-particulars at the western-defining-fixation scale the following prose names: 'improvised music has now been fixed in a formulated phrase to the degree that western words can be applied to its functionalism.' CRTF-PROG crossed with POL-P. CRTF-PROG sits at lower-center with the subject-arrow; POL-P at upper-center as partner-axis. REL-APC (relational apparatus), MO-DY (motion dynamics), MT-INTR (meta-introduction), T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication), C-INFO (central information), SOC-RT-P (social-reality particular), POL-OR (political orientation) form the upper-right chain. SOC-RT-DEVT (social-reality developmental), CULT-SOLD (culture-soldered), PER-DY (perceived dynamics) center. ECO-DY (economic dynamics), PHY-U-C (physical-universe context) lower-left.
